# policy-text-diff

> Section-aware diff of privacy policy and terms versions: headings matched across renumbering, word-level changes, review keyword flags, Markdown or JSON Python package `trysac-policy-text-diff`, import name `policy_text_diff`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
